title: Quantum study of dispersion-corrected electronic and optical properties of syn- and anti-B18H22 clusters with/without sulfur doping for tunable optoelectronics
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,50985-51017
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07768K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Fakher Abbas, Nabil Joudieh, Habib Abboud, Nidal Chamoun
This study presents a detailed quantum chemical investigation of the electronic and excited-state properties of syn- and anti-isomers of the borane cluster B18H22 and their sulfur-doped derivatives.
